data.title: Technical Project Manager – Software Development (m/w/d)
data.description:
Your mission

  • You are responsible for the operational management of our software development and ensure that our Backend and Frontend teams can deliver reliably and with clear focus. You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view.
  • You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You establish clear responsibilities, develop team members, and ensure that problems and blockers are identified and resolved early.
  • You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders.
  • You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions.
  • This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches.
  • Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards.
  • You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively.


Your profile

  • You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself.
  • You bring proven experience leading developers and development teams and have already held both functional and disciplinary leadership responsibility.
  • You have experience managing software development projects: you have coordinated multiple developers and stakeholders, owned planning and timelines, managed dependencies, and guided releases through to delivery.
  • You are technically deep enough to understand and shape architecture decisions, identify technical risks early, and discuss technical topics with experienced developers at eye level.
  • You bring strong experience in at least one of our technology areas: Python-based backend development, ideally with Django / Django REST Framework or FastAPI, or modern frontend development with React and TypeScript. Experience with the other area is a plus.
  • You understand modern SaaS architectures, REST APIs, relational databases, and the core challenges involved in developing, operating, and evolving complex web applications.
  • You can balance product requirements, technical possibilities, and available resources and communicate decisions transparently and convincingly.
  • You already use AI tools actively or are deeply engaged with how AI can change development and project processes. You evaluate new tools pragmatically, critically assess their output, and can establish successful workflows across the team.
  • You communicate clearly and convincingly and are equally comfortable coordinating with Engineering, Product Management, and senior management.
  • You bring a collaborative leadership style, strong organizational skills, and a genuine desire to shape and improve how we work.
  • You are fluent in German and English.
  • In addition to working from home, you value in-person exchange with colleagues and the sense of being part of a team.


Why us?

At Athereon GRC, we develop smart software that advances companies, organizations, and institutions across the private sector, public sector, and social services in the areas of information security and compliance. As an agile and fast-growing company, we combine technological excellence with a genuine hands-on mentality – here, your contribution truly matters.

Bring your expertise and personality to our team – we're looking for people who are passionate about IT, think outside the box, and are eager to take on responsibility.

Our client portfolio ranges from global market leaders and hidden champions to innovative mid-sized companies across a wide variety of industries – so it's guaranteed never to get boring.

data.title: Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d)
data.description:
Deine Mission

syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden, zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können.
  • Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz.
  • Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert.
  • Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen.


Dein Profil

  • Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. 
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten.
  • Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne.
  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und kannst dich gut im Team koordinieren.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch (B2).
  • Pluspunkt: Du hast Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen Architektur oder PropTech und erste Programmiererfahrungen mit Python.


Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster (ca. 1 Tag pro Woche im Office)
  • Anstellungsart: Werkstudium (12-20 Std./Woche, Zeiten flexibel)


Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.

data.title: Ecommerce Brand Manager
data.description:
Entropy sells survival, power and preparedness gear in the US. Around $525k a year, currently at contribution margin neutral. Almost all of it is other people's product resold at 9-12% margin, which caps what the business can earn.

Own-brand product and better acquisition economics are the fix. That's the job.

You'd own the P&L and report to Jack and Lasse weekly. Nobody else is doing this.

Tasks

  • Own blended gross margin, moving it from 12% to 25%, and take the business through breakeven.
  • Source and launch own-brand SKUs. Suppliers, MOQ negotiation, samples, freight, duty, 3PL, listings, launch.
  • Run paid acquisition yourself. Google Shopping, PMax and Search. There's no agency and there won't be one.
  • Site and conversion work. Product pages, imagery, copy, checkout, cart abandonment.
  • Build attach and post-purchase revenue. Checkout upsells, replenishment, email flows.
  • Restart the content engine. Video cadence, TikTok, YouTube, UGC and reviews.
  • Manage the existing dropship catalogue on margin, cutting what doesn't pay.
  • First 90 days: paid spend cut on every SKU below 15% margin, even where that drops revenue. Google Ads moved in-house. First own-brand order placed. Attach offers live at checkout. Blended gross margin at 16%.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Launched a physical product end to end. Sourced it, negotiated MOQ, approved samples, managed freight, priced it, listed it, sold it
  • Run Google Ads yourself on a Shopping-led store. In the account, not briefing an agency
  • Owned a gross margin or P&L number, not a revenue or ROAS number
  • Operated at $500k-5m, where you wrote the product page and answered the customer emails
  • Comfortable cutting revenue to fix margin
  • Work independently. No team, no budget approver, nobody checking your work between weekly calls

Nice to have:

  • Built checkout attach, upsells or replenishment flows
  • Sold consumables or anything with repeat purchase
  • Worked with Chinese suppliers, or US co-packers and contract manufacturers
  • US import, duty classification, 3PL setup
  • Klaviyo or equivalent, built from scratch rather than inherited
  • Bundle and kit pricing
  • Preparedness, outdoor, hunting or adjacent category knowledge

We're also open to people from outside ecom. Founders whose company didn't work out, consultants who want to operate, anyone who has built something and can show it. The mechanics are learnable. The instinct isn't.

Not for you if you want a team, a budget, or someone telling you what to do next week. Or if a 25% revenue drop in month one would be a problem.

Benefits

€65-75,000 base. Equity from 5%, up to 10% earned against margin and profitability targets. Quarterly bonus on gross margin. Fully remote, anywhere in Europe, hours yours.

Small business, no funding behind it, everything pays for itself out of what the store makes. Take it through breakeven and to 25% margins with a real own-brand line and you own a meaningful piece of a profitable company you built.

Entropy sits inside a wider venture portfolio. If you get this working and want to build the next thing in this space, that conversation is open.

Send us your CV and tell us which brands you've worked on. Then one product you launched: what it was, what it cost landed, what it sold for, and what you got wrong. Two paragraphs.

data.description:
About Us

Radiant is powered intelligence, delivering scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure purpose-built for AI and HPC workloads. Operating across global data centres, we run mission-critical environments where uptime, throughput, and ultra-low latency are non-negotiable.

Role Overview

We are seeking a deeply technical, hardware-passionate Datacentre Operations Engineer to execute on-the-ground operations for our new East London deployment—Radiant's newest AI infrastructure site. This role focuses on delivering precise, repeatable physical practices—including advanced smart-hands support, complex cabling, and hands-on operation of high-density, air-cooled compute systems—to guarantee world-class SLAs on next-generation hardware architecture.

Working closely with Infrastructure (HPC) SRE, Network Engineering, and Datacentre Strategy teams, you will uphold uncompromising standards across East London's data centre floor, spanning multiple data halls. You will live and breathe the hardware, maintaining elite facility reliability through hands-on deployment, proactive maintenance, rapid incident response, and structured break/fix execution across high-density air cooling systems, busbar-based power distribution, and next-generation GPU compute platforms. The role centres on technical execution and optimised output.

You will turn global engineering standards into flawless, repeatable daily routines, continually honing on-the-ground practices to keep our most advanced hardware running at peak performance. East London's hardware platform is NVIDIA B300-class, fully air-cooled compute, delivered through a new OEM partner being onboarded to Radiant's fleet; while the interfaces and overall architecture closely align with other OEM platforms you may already know, you'll be one of the first teams operating it on the ground, so a fast learning curve and strong first-principles troubleshooting matter more than prior exposure to this specific vendor.

You will be part of the founding team standing up 24x7x365 on-site coverage at East London to meet tight customer SLAs, and as Radiant expands its EMEA footprint, your relentless drive for hardware perfection and proven field expertise with high-density environments will serve as the operational blueprint to scale execution models efficiently across the region.

What’s in it for you?

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Datacentre Operations Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.

This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

You can also expect:

  • Exposure to industry-leading GPU and AI infrastructure

  • Opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly scaling global business

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive engineering culture

  • Real ownership and the ability to influence operational excellence

  • Work that sits at the intersection of people, performance, and technology

  • A modern, flexible, globally connected workplace with ambitious goals

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Operations & Break/Fix

  • Quickly diagnose and resolve hardware and network issues to maximise uptime; execute structured fault isolation methodologies to drive rapid resolution

  • Respond to critical hardware alerts via our monitoring and observability platform; contribute to ongoing service improvement to improve monitoring capability and alert quality

  • Deploy and maintain HPC and AI hardware for uninterrupted operations, including hardware troubleshooting, firmware updates, and component replacement

  • Execute break/fix procedures for advanced hardware platforms, including GPU module exchange, component-level fault isolation, and firmware-level diagnostics

  • Execute or support break/fix operations on ultra-high-density compute systems including NVIDIA B300-class chassis or equivalent platforms, including GPU/fan module exchange, chassis-level fault isolation, and busbar connection/disconnection—under the direction of the Lead where qualification is in progress

Air Cooling Operations

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain high-density air cooling infrastructure in conjunction with our datacentre partner, including CRAC/CRAH units, in-row and containment cooling, and associated airflow management systems

  • Facilitate in conjunction with our datacentre partner, routine and corrective maintenance on air cooling systems: monitoring supply/return temperatures and airflow rates, maintaining hot-aisle/cold-aisle containment and blanking, and performing scheduled filter and component inspections

  • Follow and contribute to SOPs for safe working around high-density, air-cooled compute platforms

  • Monitor thermal performance and raise anomalies before they escalate into incidents

Capacity Management

  • Contribute to site-level capacity management operations, maintaining accurate records of power, space, and cooling utilisation

  • Support capacity planning activities by providing accurate as-built data and flagging infrastructure changes to the Lead and relevant teams

  • Manage on-the-ground assets from point of purchase and delivery through lifecycle management and disposal, owning asset management within Radiant's CMDB system

Infrastructure & Facilities

  • Handle RMAs and support requests within Radiant's Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to meet customer contract SLAs

  • Contribute to ongoing maintenance, fostering compliance and leveraging strong vendor partnerships

  • Operate cooling, power distribution (including busbar and PDU infrastructure), and other critical data centre technologies to maintain high operational standards

  • Develop and maintain datacentre/hardware management SOPs, ensuring continual alignment with Radiant's governance and compliance requirements

Service & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITSM frameworks: Incident, Major Incident, Change Management, and service improvement

  • Operate and support services 24x7x365 for production environments as part of a structured on-site shift rotation—working 12-hour shifts across a 4-team pattern with two engineers on shift at all times—to meet tight customer SLAs

  • Prioritise and triage incident and smart-hands workload ensuring tight SLA coverage is maintained with a small on the ground team

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to stakeholders and customers

  • Champion a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willing to cross train and upskill in Infrastructure/Platform SRE practices

  • Willing to travel across EMEA to support future datacentre onboarding and train in new technologies

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering, or 5+ years of directly relevant industry experience in data centre operations

  • 3+ years of experience in data centre operations, HPC, or related roles

  • Passion for hardware and upholding the highest operational standards on the ground

  • Strong communication skills in English

  • Proven hands-on experience with HPC/NVIDIA GPU platforms or equivalent high-density compute systems, high-performance storage, and networking

  • Practical knowledge of high-density air cooling systems—CRAC/CRAH operation, airflow and thermal monitoring, containment management, and associated maintenance—or strong related cooling infrastructure experience

  • Experience with, or demonstrable willingness and aptitude to train on, ultra-high-density compute platforms such as NVIDIA B300, busbar-based power distribution, or equivalent systems

  • Experience with and passion for management of compute at massive scale

data.title: Talent Lead (6-month FTC)
data.description:
About Odin

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.

 

We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

 

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

 

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

 

Mission

As we prepare to scale and launch in the US, you will bring immediate senior hiring capacity into Odin to close the priority leadership and high-impact roles for Q3 and Q4.

 

Responsibilities

Reporting to Imani, our Head of People & Talent;

  • Drive the end-to-end hiring process for priority leadership and L3+ (Senior) roles, ensuring momentum, clarity, and consistent progress from kick-off to offer

  • Take full ownership of pipelines, market mapping, outbound sourcing, and candidate management for critical roles across Product, Engineering, Sales, Design, Ops, and Finance

  • Maintain structured scorecards, ensure interview feedback is timely and high quality, and support wash-ups and calibration discussions

  • Conduct thoughtful qualification calls, assessing both skills and values alignment

  • Set a high trust, human candidate experience from first touchpoint through to decision

  • Partner with hiring team in role kick-offs to turn vague or early-stage ideas into clear, aligned role definitions with crisp expectations, level, and impact areas

  • Ensure all processes begin with a grounded understanding of what “great” looks like

 

By the end of the 6 month FTC you will have partnered with the team to deliver 4–5 leadership or senior high-impact hires. We may extend the contract depending on priorities.

 

About You

  • You’re a thoughtful, experienced talent partner who cares deeply about people, process and outcomes, with strong internal filters and high standards

  • You’ve led multiple hiring processes at once, ideally in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where ambiguity, urgency and competing priorities are the norm

  • You have experience in talent operations and attention to detail – spotting blockers early, keeping things moving, and improving systems as you go

  • You’re a clear, intentional communicator across async, written and verbal channels – able to bring others with you and influence at a senior level

  • You lead confidently in ambiguity, surfacing risks, asking the right questions, and helping hiring managers move forward with aligned, quality decisions

  • You adjust your style depending on the stakeholder - balancing care with challenge, and using strategic empathy to support better thinking across the hiring team

  • You’ve got excellent hiring judgement across different functions – able to assess skills, behaviours and values alignment, not just experience on paper

  • You’re a strong sourcer who knows how to write compelling outreach and build genuine relationships with passive candidates

  • You hold high standards for candidate experience and treat people with care, even when things are moving quickly

  • You’re curious and improvement-minded - always looking for ways to make the process better, and not afraid to challenge existing norms

  • You’re calm and clear under pressure, with strong follow-through and a focus on reducing complexity

  • You take ownership for both outcomes and experience - leading processes that others can rely on, and helping us build a better hiring culture along the way

 

This role is probably not a fit if you..

  • Struggle to challenge or influence senior stakeholders – A strong candidate should be able to push back constructively, challenge thinking when needed, and drive clarity – even in rooms with senior leaders.

  • Don’t enjoy outbound work - This role requires proactive pipeline building.

  • Play back opinions rather than surfacing original thinking – We need someone who brings their own views to the table, not just someone who agrees or repeats what’s already been said.

  • Over-focuses on the what rather than the how – Someone who takes things at face value, struggles to read between the lines, or doesn’t think critically about context won’t thrive. This role requires someone who can interrogate the brief, challenge assumptions, and make sense of what’s not said as much as what is.

 

Bottom line

This isn’t about whether you’ve done 360 hiring before - it’s about how you approach it.

We’re not looking for someone to simply execute. We’re hiring a strategic partner who thinks deeply about the role hiring plays in a business, asks the right questions, and isn’t afraid to challenge when needed. You’ll be the first person every candidate meets and a key influence on how managers shape their thinking. You’re not just moving people through a process - you’re holding the bar, shaping the experience, and carrying our values at every step.

 

Salary

The salary band for this 6 month FTC is £75,000 to £100,000 pro rata. The range is intentionally broad to reflect different levels of seniority and experience.

 

Location

This role can be remote, although we work regularly from our London office and would love someone who is open to spending some initial time with us in person for onboarding. For candidates who can do a hybrid setup, we’re in the office three days a week.

 

Working at Odin

We're a fast-growing startup building something very ambitious, and we expect you to work hard and relish this challenge. However, we also offer flexibility and support your life outside of work so you can bring your best to the table.

Our benefits include:

  • Work from anywhere for up to 6 weeks a year

  • Private health insurance, paid sick leave (including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments), and free access to Spill for mental health support

  • 4% pension employer contribution, with salary sacrifice options and NI savings reinvested into your pension

  • 25 days of annual leave (pro-rata), 2 wellness days, and flexible bank holidays

  • An extra day off to celebrate your birthday

Compensation: £75K – £100K

data.title: Chief of Staff
data.description:
JOB SUMMARY

More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff.  This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide.
(Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.)


ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. 
 
We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. 
 
The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy

  • Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. 
  • CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities.
 
Organisational coordination
  • CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. 
  • Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention.
 
Leadership 
  • Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. 
  • Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values.
  • Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. 
  • Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. 
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. 
  • The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. 
  • Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages.
  • At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations.


OTHER INFORMATION

More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others:

  • Humble, ambitious and generous
  • Rigour and excellence in everything we do
  • Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship
  • Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard
  • Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond
  • Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement
  • Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers
  • Valuing courage and risk-taking
  • Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference
  • Engaging others from a starting point of trust
  • Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences
  • Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work.


COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS

  • Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy 
  • Some regular international travel
  • Personal learning budget
  • Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance.

The Role


The Sec Ops Analyst owns hands-on security monitoring and assurance across our Microsoft, AWS and Databricks environments. Working closely with our managed SOC, you'll investigate alerts and incidents, close monitoring gaps, and keep our ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls backed by complete, audit-ready evidence — including running customer and client security-assurance questionnaires on the business's behalf.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
data.description:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

Orbital's AI software platform, CurieOS, is used by scientists and engineers to design and build products serving critical industries. Powering this software are our world leading AI models in advanced materials, hardware engineering and simulation.

As Forward Deployed Engineering Lead at Orbital you will build and lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function, owning its technical standards, delivery model and team. You are an engineering leader who builds alongside customers, not a delivery leader who manages engineers. You will deliver complex deployments hands-on while hiring and developing the team that scales this capability across Orbital's growing customer base.

First and foremost, we want to work with someone with a love of craftsmanship, continual learning and building systems that scale.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver deployments hands-on, across the breadth of industrial R&D

  • Drive customer adoption so CurieOS becomes how their scientists and engineers work day-to-day

  • Deliver complex customer deployments hands-on, writing production code, designing architectures, building integrations and debugging issues across CurieOS and customer systems

  • Own the technical quality of deployments from prototype through production, including reliability, maintainability and operational performance

  • Design and build systems that connect heterogeneous software, data and physical infrastructure, from simulation campaigns and digital twins to lab instruments, test rigs and CAD/PLM systems

  • Develop reusable integration patterns that allow CurieOS to operate reliably across complex customer environments

Own delivery end-to-end

  • Embed with customer teams to understand ambiguous, high-value R&D problems, challenge assumptions and identify where CurieOS can deliver meaningful impact

  • Translate those problems into a technical approach, milestones and acceptance criteria, making pragmatic architecture and scope trade-offs as you learn

  • Own the engagement from initial technical discovery through implementation, production deployment and adoption

  • Set KPIs per engagement (screening throughput, design-cycle reduction, experiments avoided), measure pre/post and report outcomes to executive sponsors

Build and lead the team

  • Build and lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function, owning its technical standards, engineering practices and delivery model

  • Hire, develop and manage exceptional Forward Deployed Engineers across diverse scientific and engineering domains

  • Set the technical bar through code and architecture review, and act as the escalation point for the most difficult technical decisions and production issues

  • Staff engagements based on technical complexity and individual strengths, while developing engineers into increasingly independent technical leaders

  • Codify successful approaches into reusable architectures, tooling and playbooks so the team becomes more effective as it scales

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in enterprise software technical delivery or forward deployed engineering roles, you have led complex deployments and written production code alongside customers

  • Experience building a forward deployed engineering or solutions function, hiring the team, setting the standards and defining the delivery model

  • The ability to move fluidly between strategy conversations with R&D leadership and debugging sessions with engineers

  • A track record of succeeding in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where requirements evolve through direct iteration with users

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, you still build, and your technical judgement is respected by the engineers you lead

  • A genuine interest in building software that enables breakthrough scientific and industrial applications

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.description:
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
We are seeking an experienced, team-oriented Nurse to join our team at Donnington Grove on a full-time basis. We welcome applications from experienced theatre nurses from either an equine or small animal background, provided you have horse handling experience. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their nursing career within a supportive, specialist-led equine hospital.

Donnington Grove Vets is a large equine hospital and ambulatory practice based in Newbury, providing first opinion, referral and emergency services. Our impressive facilities include a full surgical suite, advanced diagnostic imaging including MRI, CT, bone scan and an on-site laboratory. 

With a strong reputation for clinical excellence and specialist-led care, we manage a varied caseload ranging from sports and leisure horses through to racehorses and foals.

Our nursing team is a huge part of what makes the practice special. You’ll work alongside colleagues at a range of experience levels, from pre-trainees through to fully qualified RVNs, as well as dedicated yard and theatre support teams. This structure provides an excellent environment for collaboration, mentoring and continued professional development.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 
As Senior Theatre Nurse, you’ll play a key role in the smooth and safe running of our equine theatre and surgical services, working closely with veterinary surgeons and the wider nursing team to deliver a high standard of patient care throughout the peri-operative period.
 
Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you’ll help lead standards within theatre, support and mentor junior colleagues and contribute to the ongoing development of our nursing protocols and ways of working.
 

Working Pattern

 
* 40 hours per week across 5 days
* Shifts between 7:00am and 8:30pm, with early and late starts to cover morning and afternoon theatre
* 1 in 7 weekends, 8:00am – 8:30pm
 

General Responsibilities

 
* Providing high-quality nursing care to equine surgical patients
* Preparing patients, theatre and equipment for emergency and elective general anaesthesia and standing procedures
* Supporting veterinary surgeons during anaesthesia and surgery
* Assisting with patient recovery and post-operative care
* Supporting and mentoring junior members of the nursing team, including acting as a Clinical Coach
* Maintaining high standards of theatre cleanliness, organisation and infection control
* Ensuring theatre equipment and consumables are maintained, prepared and ready for use
* Supporting stock control, ordering, equipment servicing and the operational running of theatre
* Contributing to the continued development of theatre protocols and nursing standards
* Working collaboratively with the wider clinical team to deliver excellent patient care
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 
We’re looking for an experienced and confident Registered Veterinary Nurse who enjoys working as part of a team and is ready to take greater responsibility within a busy theatre environment. You’ll bring:
 
* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS
* Strong theatre nursing experience gained within an equine or small animal environment
* Horse handling experience
* Confidence supporting anaesthesia, surgical procedures and peri-operative patient care
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities effectively within a busy clinical environment
* An interest in supporting, mentoring and developing other members of the nursing team
* A proactive approach to learning, reflection and continuous improvement
 

How We’ll Support You

 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:
 
* A varied and rewarding senior nursing role within a specialist-led equine hospital
* Opportunities to develop your theatre, surgical and leadership experience
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into senior nursing, referral and leadership roles, as well as Clinical Coach, mentoring and certificate pathways
* Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and specialist clinical teams
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks' annual leave plus your birthday off
* Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service
* Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and surrogacy pay
* Private Medical Insurance
* Employee wellbeing initiatives including Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme
* £550 CPD allowance plus 24 hours' paid CPD leave
* Certificate support
* RCVS and VDS fees covered
* Pension scheme
* Discounted veterinary care
* Voluntary benefits including Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme and access to discounts and cashback with hundreds of participating retailers
 

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 

Whether you’re looking to build on your theatre experience, develop your leadership skills or take the next step in your nursing career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

data.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.

As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.

  • Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance
  • Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems
  • Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Be part of an engineering organization delivering high quality, secure, and scalable solutions to Aircall clients
  • Involvement in product and platform performance optimization and live site monitoring
  • Mentor team members through giving and receiving actionable feedback.

  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (eg. computer science or mathematics). 
  • 3+ years experience with near real-time analytics
  • 5+ years experience with a modern programming language such as Scala, Python, Go, Typescript
  • Experience of designing complex data processing pipeline
  • Experience of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling etc) in AWS redshift
  • Experience of query optimisation
  • Experience of kafka is a plus

data.title: ServiceNow Technical Lead (LATAM)
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Technical Lead to support a major GRC/IRM implementation project.

The project will migrate the organization's Governance, Risk & Compliance processes from Archer GRC to ServiceNow, covering areas including Information Security, Enterprise Risk, Data Privacy, Third-Party Risk, and Business Continuity.

The Technical Lead will be responsible for the technical design, architecture, development and implementation of the ServiceNow solution and will provide technical leadership to the wider implementation team.

Tasks

  • Lead the technical design and architecture of the ServiceNow GRC/IRM solution.
  • Design and oversee Entity Mapping to support the IRM implementation.
  • Configure and develop ServiceNow solutions, including workflows, integrations and custom applications.
  • Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Risk teams, IT Project Managers and other stakeholders to understand and translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture and technical standards.
  • Lead technical activities across development, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
  • Oversee data migration and system integrations, including technical documentation.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to ServiceNow developers and other implementation team members.
  • Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate solutions or alternative technologies where required.
  • Support Agile/hybrid delivery, including sprint planning and technical delivery activities.

Requirements

  • 5–8+ years of ServiceNow experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow GRC / IRM.

  • Experience with several of the following:

  • Integrated Risk Management (IRM)

  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Security Operations (SecOps)

  • Privacy Management

  • Third-Party Risk Management

  • Business Continuity Management (BCM)

  • Experience designing and delivering complex ServiceNow implementations.

  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow integrations, workflows, development and configuration.

  • Experience with data migration and application integration.

  • 10+ years of overall IT/project implementation experience preferred.

  • Understanding of information security, enterprise risk and data privacy.

  • Experience leading technical teams or mentoring developers.

  • Strong stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working with Agile or hybrid methodologies.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

data.title: Customer Service Executive
data.description:
At Bike Club, we offer subscriptions for children's bikes that grow with your kids. Families pay a monthly fee, and when their children outgrow their bikes, we exchange them for a larger size. We refurbish the used bikes and make them available to other families. It's sustainable and hassle-free.

With over 80,000 bikes, we are the second-largest bike rental network globally, and the largest in the children's bike sector. While our headquarters is in the United Kingdom, we are also active in Germany.

Tasks

At Bike Club, our members come first, and our Customer Service and Success Team is what brings that to life. It's a role that blends service with a proactive mindset. Part of it is the day-to-day: helping members with subscriptions, billing, deliveries and choosing the right bike. The rest is proactive: reaching out at the right moments, supporting retention, and making sure every family feels looked after from start to finish. No two days are the same, and we love it that way! You will:

  • Handle member queries across multiple channels, including email, telephone, and social media.
  • Develop expert product knowledge of our bicycle range to offer tailored advice and recommendations to our members.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by gathering feedback and sharing insights with your team.
  • Conduct proactive outreach to members at key moments in their journey.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively, ensuring information is always shared clearly and concisely.
  • Demonstrate a solution-focused approach by resolving issues on the first contact whenever possible.

This role will grow as our team does, so if you like the idea of shaping something rather than slotting into a fixed box, you'll fit right in.

Requirements

  • Genuinely care about offering the highest level of customer service.
  • Previous experience with CRM tools, preferably Salesforce.
  • A proactive mindset, happy to reach out to members at the right moments rather than waiting for them to come to you.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, coupled with a natural curiosity and a desire to learn.
  • A high level of empathy and a commitment to exceeding customer expectations.
  • You actively seek out feedback to help yourself grow and improve.
  • Love the dynamic of a team environment, but are just as comfortable working independently.
  • You can remain positive when the going gets tough and when working under pressure.
  • A dependable, organised, and dedicated team player.
  • At least 1 year of real-life experience in a similar role.

Benefits

  • Remote first – work from anywhere in the UK. You will be required to attend a monthly in-person team meeting at our warehouse in East London
  • Flexible hours – 37.5 working hours per week. While some weekend availability is required, we’re open to different work patterns. Our core hours are Monday - Friday, 9 am - 5:30 pm.
  • Holidays – 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with additional days accrued for each year worked
  • Private health insurance - via Vitality
  • Sustainability impact – you will be working for a B Corp Certified company that actively contributes to environmental and social good
  • Parental leave – enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Bike subscription – £30/month discount towards Bike Club subscription

Apply Today! We invite you to forward your CV and a cover letter expressing your enthusiasm for the core values and vision of Bike Club. Join us, and let’s embark on this trailblazing journey together!

Senior Full Stack Engineer (Realtime & Voice) Customer Experience Platform
data.description:
About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the world's largest travel brands. We're looking for a senior full stack engineer to anchor this product, owning the realtime and voice layer end to end while building across React/TypeScript front ends, Scala and Python services, and cloud infrastructure. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the path from your code to a traveler's phone call is short.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the voice channel end to end, including telephony and CPaaS integrations (e.g., Twilio, Amazon Connect), streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, realtime model orchestration, and latency and quality budgets

  • Build product features across the stack, including web chat front ends in React/TypeScript, backend services in Scala and Python, and infrastructure on GCP

  • Design for multi-tenant scale, with one codebase serving many partners through configuration rather than forks

  • Build the safety and compliance plumbing enterprise partners audit, including guardrails, content filtering, and PII redaction integration points

  • Keep revenue-critical deployments healthy through observability, alerting, incident response, and SLA performance

  • Build the platform capabilities forward-deployed engineers configure for partner telephony integrations and go-lives

  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, architecture reviews, and mentoring

An ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with senior-level ownership of production systems and genuine full-stack range

  • Hands-on realtime systems experience, such as voice applications, WebRTC/SIP, streaming media, or comparable low-latency products

  • Strength in a modern front end (React, TypeScript) and depth on the backend (Scala or another JVM language, and/or Python), along with cloud infrastructure experience on GCP or AWS

  • A track record designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven systems

  • Familiarity using AI coding tools as a standard part of their workflow, with the judgment to review, correct, and own everything that ships

  • An operable-systems mindset, covering SLAs, observability, on-call rotations, and rollback plans

  • The ability to break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and ship iteratively, backed by strong communication across product, design, and operations

  • Bonus points for conversational AI or LLM orchestration experience, including speech technologies such as Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper, or OpenAI Realtime

  • Bonus points for working knowledge of cloud telephony or CPaaS platforms such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys, or LiveKit

  • Bonus points for experience building customer service, CRM, contact center, or workflow automation tools

  • Familiarity with travel industry technologies (PSS/GDS, hotel PMS/CRS) is a plus, though not required

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

  • Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams, massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS' channels every year.

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus if they booked just travel.

  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
data.description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

That takes high standards, high velocity and engineers who own what they ship.

Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management. At that scale, frontend architecture, performance and product quality have material business consequences.

Our frontend platform spans web and mobile: TypeScript, React, React Native and React Native Web in an Nx and pnpm monorepo, with TanStack Query, Zustand, Playwright, Detox and Jest. Around 95% of our code is reused across web and mobile.

About the role

Staff Frontend Engineers shape architecture and engineering direction across product teams while remaining close to the code. Your scope will include shared libraries, platform capabilities, developer tooling and difficult product-system problems.

This is not a people-management role. Its leverage comes from technical judgement, credible execution and making other engineers and teams more effective.

What you’ll do

  • Set direction for frontend architecture across React, React Native and the shared monorepo.

  • Own cross-team problems in platform capabilities, shared libraries, design-system foundations, tooling and developer experience.

  • Lead decisions on boundaries, abstractions, state and data flow, performance, testing and migration strategy.

  • Diagnose systemic rendering, bundle, runtime and release-quality problems and create durable fixes.

  • Remain hands-on where implementation, prototyping or technical investigation is the fastest way to create clarity.

  • Partner with product, backend engineering and QA on risks and decisions that cross team boundaries.

  • Mentor senior engineers, raise review quality and make sound frontend judgement easier to reproduce across teams.

  • Balance standardisation with team autonomy, avoiding platform work that creates more friction than leverage.

What you need to have

  • Evidence of architectural or platform impact across multiple frontend teams.

  • Deep ownership of complex production systems built with React or React Native and TypeScript.

  • Strong judgement in application boundaries, shared libraries, state management, performance and migration design.

  • A track record of improving developer effectiveness, reliability or product quality through durable mechanisms.

  • Practical experience diagnosing performance and correctness problems across web or mobile systems.

  • The ability to influence technical direction through evidence, clarity and trusted execution rather than title.

  • Clear communication that helps teams act on complex technical decisions.

  • Strong engineering and product judgement, including knowing when not to introduce a new abstraction.

Staff scope is assessed through ownership, judgement and sustained organisational impact—not years of experience or familiarity with every technology listed.

What to expect

  • Recruiter conversation

  • Code Review

  • Experience Deep Dive

  • Managerial interview

Your recruiter will explain each stage clearly and follow up after every conversation.

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

 

About the role

 

As a Customer Director at Faculty, you will serve as a trusted partner and strategic lead for the largest technology and lab clients, advancing the frontier of safe, trustworthy, and audit-ready AI systems. Blending deep technical credibility with delivery leadership, you will guide government bodies, Frontier labs, and high-impact organisations through complex AI safety, evaluation, and red-teaming challenges.

You will own key client relationships, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Partnering with senior client leaders to translate complex safety, governance, and technical AI concepts into actionable strategy and impactful programmes.

  • Overseeing delivery excellence across cross-functional teams of engineers, researchers, and delivery leads to ensure high-stakes projects succeed.

  • Developing commercial strategies and proposals that expand our work across safety-critical domains while meeting ambitious growth goals.

  • Championing thought leadership by sharing insights on AI safety frameworks, emerging risk evaluation, and industry standards with senior stakeholders

 

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You bring deep expertise in AI safety, auditing, ethics, or evaluation methodologies, developed through time in government, research labs, or tech-forward environments.

The Interview Process

data.title: GTM
data.description:
We're Heidi

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, we might be a good place for you to start.

Our perspective on GTM

We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls.

The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits.

  • Intellectual dexterity: consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here.

  • Natural charisma: can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere.

  • Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening.

  • The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human.

We don't think the talent market has caught up with how GTM is changing, so we’re open minded - title or experience isn’t important. Most of our team started outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common.

This role is high leverage, highly rewarding, and intellectually stimulating. We want you to be part of that.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is genuinely open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn that quiet enthusiasm into real revenue conversations.

You're the first line to Heidi. Inbound demand and product signals point you at practices and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. The signals tell you who to reach out to, you decide how.

This is the first rung of our UK sales org, and for most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. How they feel about us afterwards is largely down to you. You'll triage the inbound to your Account Executive's where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across UK healthcare that outlasts the role.

What this means practically:

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed

  • Keep the CRM accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get

  • Track what's shifting in UK healthcare and across the competitive set, then tell the team what you're hearing on the phones

What you'll need

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, creative, banking, consulting or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product actually works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have twenty patients before lunch. You respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Organised and autonomously functioning. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude beats experience here. If you're hungry, competitive and you like solving the problem in front of you, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.
