🚀 Werde unser neue Forward Deployed Product Strategist (m/w/d)

Du willst KI nicht nur strategisch denken, sondern messbaren Business Impact schaffen? Du denkst 0-to-1, hast eine Builder-Mentalität und bewegst dich sicher zwischen Vorstand, Product und Engineering.

Unser Ansatz: AI-Native Execution – relevante Opportunities identifizieren, schnell umsetzen und Data & AI dort produktiv machen, wo echter Mehrwert entsteht.

Deine Rolle als Forward Deployed Product Strategist

Du verbindest Strategie, Product Thinking, Hands-on Execution und Account Ownership.

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden identifizierst du die relevantesten Data-&-AI-Opportunities und treibst sie mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers von Discovery und Validierung bis in die produktive Nutzung und Skalierung.

Dein Erfolg misst sich nicht an Slides, Features oder Backlogs, sondern daran, was tatsächlich genutzt wird, messbaren Business Impact erzielt und beim Kunden weiter skaliert werden kann.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

Du verantwortest Data-&-AI-Opportunities end-to-end – von Discovery bis Production – und übernimmst dabei strategische, kommerzielle, fachliche und technische Verantwortung:

  • Opportunity Discovery: Du arbeitest direkt mit Business-Verantwortlichen, Führungskräften und Nutzer zusammen, verstehst ihre Prozesse und Herausforderungen und identifizierst die Data-&-AI-Opportunities mit dem größten potenziellen Business Impact.

  • Account Ownership & Growth: Du bist eine zentrale Bezugsperson für den Kunden, entwickelst ein kohärentes Zielbild für den Einsatz von Data & AI und baust bestehende Engagements durch neue, wertstiftende Opportunities strategisch weiter aus.

  • Product Discovery & Priorisierung: Du übersetzt komplexe Business-Probleme in konkrete Produkt- und Lösungshypothesen, priorisierst nach Business Value, Machbarkeit und Nutzerbedarf und entscheidest, was zuerst validiert werden muss.

  • Rapid Prototyping (0-to-1): Du baust selbst erste funktionierende Prototypen, testest sie mit echten Nutzer und nutzt die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse, um schnell über Weiterentwicklung, Anpassung oder Stopp zu entscheiden.

  • Production & Scale: Gemeinsam mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers entwickelst du validierte Prototypen zu robusten, produktionsreifen Lösungen weiter. Als Owner der Opportunity bleibst du vom ersten Konzept bis zur produktiven Nutzung und Skalierung verantwortlich.

  • Partnerschaft mit Forward Deployed Engineers: Du arbeitest eng im Tandem mit unseren Engineers. Du bringst Business-Kontext, Product Thinking und Rapid Prototyping ein; gemeinsam verbindet ihr diese mit Engineering Excellence und integriert Lösungen in bestehende Architekturen, Datenlandschaften und Prozesse.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Du agierst als Trusted Advisor für Senior- und Executive-Stakeholder und berätst sie zu KI-Potenzialen, Investitionsentscheidungen, Prioritäten sowie technologischen und geschäftlichen Trade-offs.

  • Outcome Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis – nicht nur für Deliverables. Entscheidend sind produktive Nutzung, Adoption, Business Impact und die nachhaltige Skalierung erfolgreicher Lösungen.



Das bringst du mit – deine Skills & Erfahrung

  • Business-Value-Orientierung: Du kannst komplexe und zunächst unscharfe Business-Probleme strukturieren, die entscheidenden Hebel identifizieren und daraus priorisierte, umsetzbare Data-&-AI-Initiativen ableiten.

  • Product Thinking: Du denkst vom Problem und Nutzerbedarf aus, formulierst Hypothesen, validierst früh und priorisierst konsequent nach Wirkung statt nach Feature-Menge.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Senior- und Executive-Stakeholder zu technologischen Möglichkeiten, Business Value und Trade-offs zu beraten – von Pre-Sales und Discovery bis zur Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Engagements.

  • 0-to-1 Delivery: Du hast einen nachweisbaren Track Record darin, aus einer Idee schnell etwas Testbares zu bauen, mit echten Nutzer zu validieren und anhand von Feedback, Daten und operativen Ergebnissen zu iterieren. Builder-Mentalität statt reiner Slide-Produktion.

  • High Agency: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, schaffst Klarheit in unstrukturierten Situationen und kommst auch dann voran, wenn Problem, Scope oder Lösungsweg zu Beginn noch nicht vollständig definiert sind.

  • Umgang mit Komplexität: Du kannst mit komplexen Prozessen, gewachsenen Systemlandschaften und großen, unstrukturierten oder qualitativ heterogenen Datenbeständen umgehen, ohne den Fokus auf schnelle Ergebnisse zu verlieren.

  • Hands-on AI & Technology: Du verfügst über ein solides technisches Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung beim Entwickeln von Data-&-AI-Anwendungen – beispielsweise mit Python, APIs, LLMs und modernen AI-Toolchains. Du kannst selbst einen funktionierenden Prototyp bauen und technischen Teams auf Augenhöhe begegnen.

  • Commercial Mindset: Du erkennst, wo aus einem erfolgreichen Use Case weiteres Potenzial entsteht, und kannst daraus gemeinsam mit dem Kunden neue Initiativen und langfristige Engagements entwickeln.

Ausbildung

Du hast einen Studienabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft mit technischem Schwerpunkt oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet. Noch wichtiger ist uns jedoch, dass du relevante praktische Erfahrung und einen nachweisbaren Track Record mitbringst.

Sprachkenntnisse – Deutsch ist für diese Rolle unverzichtbar

Du verfügst über fließende, verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, da du eigenständig mit deutschsprachigen Stakeholdern bis auf Executive-Level arbeitest. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch setzen wir ebenfalls voraus.

Warum du bei uns genau richtig bist

  • AI-Native Execution: Wir verbinden strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzung – schnell vom Problem zur validierten Lösung und von dort in die produktive Nutzung.

  • Data & AI mit echtem Impact: Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen Data-&-AI-Challenges – von der ersten Opportunity bis zur produktiven und skalierbaren Lösung.

  • Ownership statt Zuarbeit: Du bekommst Verantwortung für Kunden, Opportunities und Outcomes. Wir suchen Menschen, die Entscheidungen treffen, Dinge bauen und Ergebnisse verantworten – nicht nur Empfehlungen formulieren.

  • Strategie trifft Engineering: Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Product und Technologie und eng mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers zusammen.

  • Steile Lernkurve & Entwicklung: Du arbeitest mit einem starken Team aus Data-, AI-, Product- und Engineering-Expert und entwickelst dich durch anspruchsvolle Projekte, regelmäßige Trainings und Zertifizierungen kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Hands-on Unternehmenskultur: Kurze Wege, hohe Eigenverantwortung, Teamspirit und der Anspruch, aus neuen Technologien messbaren Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Über KI performance

Wir transformieren die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen mit Daten arbeiten, und machen sie bereit für die Zukunft der Künstlichen Intelligenz. Mit unserer Expertise in der Entwicklung von Datenplattformen und KI-gestützten Lösungen schaffen wir messbaren Mehrwert – stets mit einem klaren Fokus auf Business und Strategie. Unsere Projekte reichen von globalen Datenplattformen bis hin zu innovativen Gen AI-Anwendungen und leisten einen direkten Beitrag zum Erfolg führender DAX-Unternehmen. Durch den Einsatz modernster Technologien setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in der digitalen Transformation und arbeiten eng mit Microsoft, Databricks und unserem KI group-Ecosystem zusammen, um nachhaltige und zukunftsweisende Lösungen zu realisieren.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von zukunftsorientierten, neugierigen und aufgeschlossenen Menschen, die die digitale Welt aktiv gestalten. Um dieses dynamische Umfeld zu erhalten, legen wir großen Wert auf Vielfalt, Innovation und eine enge Zusammenarbeit in Teams. Wenn du mehr über unsere Kultur und Benefits erfahren möchtest, schaue gerne auf unserer Karriereseite vorbei.

Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft datengetriebener Geschäftsmodelle zu gestalten?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt – Wir freuen uns auf dich! 🚀

data.title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d) German speaking
data.description:
Why we are looking for support

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team in Germany. 

You’ll be part of a delivery team working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, B2B Commerce, and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud. While you don’t need prior experience with Consumer Goods Cloud, you’ll be expected to learn and work with it as part of our core solution landscape.

This is a German-speaking position. Professional fluency in German and English is required, as you will work directly with German-speaking clients and international project teams.

To give you more insights of your working environment, on the organization level you will work on a regular basis in a team of 5-10 developers to gather ideas & improve already existing processes. On a project level you will work in an agile project team of 4-7 people, depending on the project size, to deliver projects to our clients.
What you will find with us: 

  • Real-world Salesforce projects that go beyond textbook use cases
  • A team that values thoughtful engineering, scalable delivery, and ownership
  • Opportunities to learn Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud in live client environments
  • Clear growth paths toward technical lead, solution architect, or industry specialist roles


Your tasks

  • Lead the development, and deployment of Salesforce solutions using different Cloud solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end Salesforce solutions using both configuration and customization
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and deliver scalable solutions
  • Develop Salesforce components using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows
  • Work closely with solution architects and functional consultants to build scalable solutions across Sales, Service, Commerce, and Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using APIs and middleware tools (e.g. MuleSoft, SAP CPI)
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality assurance
  • Contribute to DevOps automation using Git, Gearset, or DevOps Center
  • Suggest improvements to performance, reusability, or developer experience
  • Support defect resolution, enhancements, and roll-out activities
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest Salesforce innovations and contribute to internal initiatives and team growth.


Requirements

  • 3–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong skills in Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, and Flow
  • Experience working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Commerce implementations
  • Understanding of integration design, platform limits, and test automation
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control and CI/CD tooling
  • Experience working in structured project teams or consulting environments
  • Interest in learning Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and applying it in real-world programs
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex technical issues.
  • Fluent in English and German - other languages are a plus.
  • Demonstrated drive to improve how things are done—whether in performance, automation, or usability
  • The ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams
  • A mindset geared toward learning and adapting in enterprise-scale environments


Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Integration Architecture Designer)
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, CPQ, or Consumer Goods Cloud
  • Background working with or delivering for consumer goods or retail clients
  • Familiarity with agile delivery tools like JIRA, Confluence, and TestRail
  • Experience working with XML based design contracts and Cordova mobile framework

data.title: (Senior) Social Media & Video Editor (m/w/d)
data.description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Du denkst Social Media nicht nur in Posts, sondern in Formaten, Geschichten und Marken?
Du kannst aus einer Strategie einen Redaktionsplan entwickeln und aus Rohmaterial Content, der Menschen wirklich erreicht?
Du hast Lust, Verantwortung für Kunden und deren Content zu übernehmen und Social Media redaktionell, strategisch und in der Produktion durchzudenken?

Dann suchen wir dich als Senior Social Media & Video Editor (m/w/d) für unser adfriends-Team!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Social-Media-Formate und Redaktionskonzepte entlang von Markenstrategie, Zielgruppen und Plattformlogiken und übernimmst die Redaktionsplanung inkl. Posting
  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Social Accounts und bringst eigene Ideen und Impulse ein
  • Du verantwortest das Community Management und Publishing ausgewählter Accounts und entwickelst unsere Redaktionsleitfäden und Content-Guidelines kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du bereitest redaktionelle Drehs vor, bist vor Ort redaktionell verantwortlich, führst Interviews und erkennst bereits am Set, welche Geschichten, Szenen und Assets für Social funktionieren
  • Du übernimmst den redaktionellen Schnitt in Adobe Premiere, entwickelst aus Rohmaterial plattformgerechte Social Assets und koordinierst externe sowie interne Cutter in der Postproduktion
  • Du textest Captions, Hooks und Social Copy für Organic Content sowie Texte und Headlines für Kampagnen und andere Kommunikationsformate


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Redaktion, Content oder Video mit – idealerweise auf Agentur- oder Produktionsseite
  • Du denkst strategisch und redaktionell, kannst aber genauso gut selbst ins Tool gehen und Content umsetzen
  • Ein sehr gutes Gespür für Social Trends, Plattformlogiken und relevante Formate zeichnet dich aus
  • Deine Kenntnisse in Adobe Premiere sind sehr gut - weitere Adobe-Programme sind ein Plus
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der redaktionellen Drehvorbereitung und Drehbegleitung
  • Du hast ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling und unterschiedliche Brand Tonalities
  • Beratungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus: Du kannst Kunden gegenüber souverän auftreten, beraten und deine Empfehlungen argumentieren
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei mehreren Kunden und Produktionen den Überblick

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab


Deine Benefits

  • Friend ist Programm: Wir nennen es zuerst, denn das macht uns aus: Kolleg:innen, die sich Freunde nennen, füreinander einstehen und mit denen es Spaß macht zu arbeiten
  • Volle Flexibilität: Bei uns entscheidest du über Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort – Hybrid-Work und Homeoffice? Wie es für dich gerade am besten passt!
  • Zukunftsorientiertes Arbeiten: Wir arbeiten am Puls der Zeit und setzen aktiv auf KI in unserem Leistungsportfolio
  • JobRad-Leasing: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder die Wochenendtour – bei uns kannst du dein Wunschrad ganz einfach leasen
  • Mobilität nach Wahl: Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Arbeitsweg mit einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und der Option auf einen Tankgutschein 
  • Work-Life-Balance: Schätzen wir genau wie Du und ist mit unserem flexiblen Arbeitsmodell gesichert.
  • Urlaubstage: 28 + 2 * 0,5 freie Tage für Weihnachten und Silvester
  • After-Work-Programm: Neben der Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft und regelmäßigen Team-Events erwartet dich unsere jährliche Workation
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir bieten spannende Projekte und stetige Weiterentwicklung in einer Organisationskultur, in der der Status Quo auch hinterfragt werden darf
  • Drinks & Snacks: In unseren Büros findest du alles für dein Wohlbefinden – Kaffee, Limonade, Bier, frisches Obst und vieles mehr

Beim Lesen der Stellenanzeige dachtest du dir "Hell Yes!"?

Dann schick uns deinen CV mit deinen Gehaltsvorstellungen und möglichem Startdatum an  .

data.title: Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung (all Genders)
data.description:
DEINE KÜNFTIGE ROLLE.

Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung: Führen und selbst entwickeln.

Als Tech Lead übernimmst Du die technische Führung der Entwicklungsteams und stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nachhaltig, skalierbar und wartbar umgesetzt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern und Entwicklern zusammen, übersetzt Architekturvorgaben in konkrete Lösungen und unterstützt die Teams bei technischen Entscheidungen. Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Umsetzung moderner Softwarearchitekturen, der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Entwicklungsprozesse sowie der Förderung technischer Exzellenz innerhalb der Teams. Dabei bleibst Du hands-on und entwickelst aktiv mit.

Wie die Rolle heißt, ist uns dabei weniger wichtig als das, was Du darin tust – bei anderen Arbeitgebern findest Du sie als Teamleitung Softwareentwicklung oder als Engineering Lead.

Klingt gut für Dich? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns!

Welche Aufgaben erwarten mich in meiner Rolle?
  • Technische Führung, Coaching und Coding-Unterstützung von Entwicklerteams.
  • Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Architekturvorgaben.
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Einführung neuer Produkte und Funktionen.
  • Verantwortung für die technische Qualität der entwickelten Software.
  • Definition und Durchsetzung von Entwicklungsstandards und Best Practices.
  • Mitarbeit bei Architekturentscheidungen sowie Erstellung technischer Konzepte.
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau und Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mitarbeit bei Deployments.
  • Entwicklung und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines.
  • Sicherstellung von Security-Anforderungen und Secure-Coding-Praktiken.
  • Unterstützung bei Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Konzepten.
  • Analyse und Lösung technischer Herausforderungen und Performance-Probleme.
  • Koordination technischer Aktivitäten innerhalb agiler Entwicklungsteams.
  • Durchführung von Code Reviews und Förderung hoher Softwarequalität.
  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne Stakeholder und Kunden.
Welche Fähigkeiten sollte ich mitbringen, um Teil des Teams zu werden?

Du begegnest Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit Respekt – nicht nur als Selbstverständlichkeit, sondern als gelebte Haltung. Dein klares Wertesystem prägt Dein tägliches Handeln und wird ergänzt durch einen Sinn für Humor, der das Team verbindet und für eine positive, motivierende Atmosphäre sorgt.

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie erste Erfahrung in technischer Führung.
  • Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen und agilen Entwicklungsmethoden.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Cloud-native-Architekturen, Container-Technologien und CI/CD.
  • Erfahrung in der Umsetzung skalierbarer und wartbarer Softwarelösungen.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und Bereitschaft, selbst aktiv zu entwickeln.

Technologische Kompetenzen:

  • Container & Runtime: Docker, Linux.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): YAML-basierte Modelle.
  • Cloud & On-Prem: AWS, Azure.
  • Datenarchitekturen: MSSQL, Kafka, Spark, PostgreSQL.
  • Frontend-Frameworks: React, Angular oder Vue.
  • Testingframeworks: JUnit und Cypress.
  • Security & IAM: TLS, Keycloak, LDAP, OAuth.
  • Entwicklungsframeworks: SPA, Java, Spring, Spring Boot.

Erwünschte Kompetenzen:

  • Kubernetes.
  • Monitoring und Logging: Grafana.
  • BPMN und Orchestrierung.
  • Python und KI.
  • Erfahrung im Versicherungs- oder Krankenversicherungsumfeld.
  • Kenntnisse der Versicherungs-Anwendungs-Architektur (VAA).
  • Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen (DSGVO, ISO 27001, BSI).
  • Erfahrung mit Architektur-Reviews und technischen Qualitätsprozessen.
  • Erfahrung in der Einführung von Best Practices und Architektur-Governance.
  • Hervorragende Fähigkeiten in Problemlösung, Kommunikation und Kenntnis von Best Practices.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Leadership-Skills, Fähigkeit zur Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams.
  • Innovationsfreude und strategisches Denken, gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität.

Sprachkenntnisse:

  • Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1).
  • Englisch verhandlungssicher.


Mehr Details zu der Position findest du hier: 
https://www.globalside.com/tech-lead-softwareentwicklung


WAS UNS ANTREIBT.

Verantwortung, Konzentration, Fortschritt.

Unsere DNA ist unser Fundament – sie verbindet uns und treibt uns voran. Gemeinsam übernehmen wir Verantwortung, setzen klare Prioritäten und denken immer einen Schritt voraus. Wir schaffen Vertrauen, feiern Erfolge und wachsen kontinuierlich – als Team und als Einzelpersonen. Für uns ist jeder Tag eine neue Chance, besser zu werden.

Du willst mehr erfahren? Schau Dir unsere Website https://www.globalside.com/karriere an und finde heraus, was GLOBAL SIDE ausmacht!

DEINE VORTEILE AM STANDORT MÜNCHEN.
  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell mit hybrider Organisation.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr.
  • Dienstrad-Leasing.
  • Deutschland-Ticket.
  • Personalisiertes Ausbildungsbudget für Dein berufliches Wachstum.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events mit Spaßfaktor.
  • Jährliche Unternehmenstage an der Algarve in Portugal.
  • Jährlicher Team-Wiesn-Besuch.

In unserer offenen und einladenden Kultur stehen Deine Stärken im Mittelpunkt. Wir glauben daran, dass die besten Jobs diejenigen sind, an denen Du persönlich wachsen kannst, die auf Deinen einzigartigen Fähigkeiten basieren und Dir tagtäglich Freude bereiten. Bei uns genießt Du die Freiheiten und die dynamische Atmosphäre eines Start-up-Unternehmens, während Du gleichzeitig von unserem tiefgehenden Fachwissen und einem seit 2002 stetig wachsenden, treuen Kundenstamm profitierst. data.title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
data.description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.


Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.
  • Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.
  • Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.
  • Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.
  • You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.
  • You are excited to show your work (portfolio or examples).
  • Ideally you've worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences (fintech, healthtech, logistics, compliance), but that's not a must-have.
  • Berlin-based or willing to relocate.
This role is not for you if…
  • You want a PM to define the problem and an engineer to implement the solution.
  • You resist working in code or with AI.
  • You hand off polished Figma files and believe your job is done.
  • You judge yourself on taste alone, not outcomes.

Interview process:

  1. First Call — Intro on what we do with Max (Hiring manager) 
  2. Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Sebastian (Designer) 
  3. Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Product team (group call)
  4. On-site Day — Meet our team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.
  5. (Potentially) quick ,,vibe check'' call- with founder (Leonie or Hendrik)


Why us?

What you can expect

  • Enjoy benefits like an Urban Sports Club membership
  • Varied day-to-day → every problem comes with unique needs, so no two days are the same
  • Visible impact → you'll see the direct results of your work for both our customers and traide AI
  • Direct impact on product → your decisions ship and shape what users touch every day
  • Flexible working → we work in a hybrid mode, with an office in senfelderplatz and home office options. 
  • Be part of our regular team events (boat trips, bowling, etc.)

Die Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt sucht

eine:n Data Analyst:in Fundraising (m/w/d)

zum nächstmöglichen Termin in Berlin (hoher Homeoffice-Anteil möglich) mit 35 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit) in Festanstellung.

Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der kein Tier mehr für die Herstellung von Lebensmitteln leidet. Unsere Mission lautet: Gemeinsam Tierschutzstandards erhöhen und den Verbrauch von Tierprodukten senken. Mit unserer Arbeit wirken wir in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Recht und Politik. Auf allen Ebenen gehen wir mit den jeweiligen Akteur:innen praktikable Schritte in Richtung eines respektvollen Umgangs mit den Tieren und erleichtern auch vermeintlichen Gegner:innen den Ausstieg aus bisherigen Handlungsmustern.


Als Data Analyst:in Fundraising bist du Teil unseres sechsköpfigen Fundraising & Engagement-Teams. Der Bereich Fundraising & Engagement verbindet engagierte Menschen mit unserer Mission - als Spender:innen oder Freiwillige. Mit kreativen Aktionen sichert er die Finanzierung unserer Arbeit.


Das bewirkst du bei uns

Du entwickelst und pflegst ein skalierbares Performance-Monitoring für den Bereich Fundraising und Engagement. Darüber hinaus optimierst du Fundraising- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen und stellst Datenqualität und Datenintegrität sicher.

Damit sorgst du dafür, dass Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen datenbasiert geplant, segmentiert, ausgewertet und optimiert werden können. Mit KPI-Reportings, Tests und Analysen lieferst du belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Weiterentwicklung von Fundraising, Mobilisierung und Unterstützer:innen-Journeys.


Im Einzelnen bedeutet das

  • Du segmentierst und bereitest Daten für Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen vor

  • Du entwickelst, pflegst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen und wiederkehrende Auswertungslogiken

  • Du wertest Fundraising-, Engagement- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen entlang vereinbarter KPIs aus

  • Du erstellst Monatsreportings und Dashboards mit den wichtigsten Steuerungskennzahlen

  • Du bereitest A/B- und multivariate Tests vor, wertest sie aus und leitest Learnings ab

Dein Profil


  • Idealerweise hast du einen Studienabschluss oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Fundraising, BWL, Controlling, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Statistik oder Data Science. Wir sind aber auch offen für Quereinsteiger:innen mit entsprechenden nachgewiesenen Qualifikationen und Referenzen.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken und CRM Systemen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit A/B- und multivariatem Testing.

  • Auf Unvorhergesehenes reagierst du flexibel und suchst passende Alternativen.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen - auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung damit, KI-Tools reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen und weißt, dass gute Ergebnisse klare Aufgabenstellungen, ausreichend Kontext und eine sorgfältige Prüfung brauchen.

  • Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des F&E-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz.

  • Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro).

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?

data.title: Growth Account Executive - DACH (all genders)
data.description:
Our mission

We're on a mission to create 10 million human firewalls! At revel8, we redefine cybersecurity training with hyper-realistic simulations that reflect today's evolving attack landscape. Our innovative platform combines AI-driven multi-channel attacks with gamified, real-time learning to build resilience where it matters most: the people.


Your mission

We're scaling our core business across the DACH region, and you're right at the heart of it. As a Growth Account Executive, you own the full sales cycle for SMB and key accounts in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland: from first conversation to signed deal. You are the person who turns qualified opportunities into real revenue and builds the relationships that carry revel8 in the DACH market.

How your day-to-day will look like:

  • Own the Full Cycle: You run the sales process end to end — qualifying opportunities, running discovery, giving demos, handling objections, and closing. You take real ownership of your pipeline and your number.
  • Close New Business: You turn qualified opportunities into signed customers, negotiating with decision-makers and navigating DACH-specific buying dynamics to bring deals over the line.
  • Build the Playbook: You are early enough to shape how we sell. You test messaging, refine our approach to local buyers, and feed what works back into a repeatable playbook.
  • Represent revel8: You are the face of our company in DACH, from customer calls to webinars and events. You understand the specific needs of local clients and channel those insights directly into our product and global growth.
  • Work Cross-Functionally: You partner closely with our SDR, marketing, and product teams to keep your pipeline healthy and to make sure the voice of the market is heard across the company.


Is it you we are looking for?

You...

  • have a completed degree, whether in Business, Economics, Engineering, or another field that sharpened your analytical thinking and drive. We welcome diverse backgrounds; what matters most is what you bring to the role, not the exact subject on your diploma.
  • have first experience as an SDR or in sales with a strong track record, ideally in B2B SaaS or another fast-paced environment. You've already built pipeline, qualified opportunities, and talked to potential customers.
  • want to take the next step into full-cycle sales: You're eager to own your own deals, negotiate, and close . And to grow with real ownership.
  • are a motivated, goal-oriented self-starter: You take initiative, work independently, and thrive with real ownership. Ambitious targets energize you rather than scare you.
  • are curious & adaptable: You love opening up something new, challenging the status quo, and finding what works.
  • are excited about cybersecurity & AI: You're curious about how AI is transforming the security space and eager to rethink how security awareness is done.
  • are tech-savvy: You're comfortable with modern sales tooling (CRM, outreach, automation) and happy to build scalable processes as we grow.
  • are fluent in German (business proficient) and English: German is a must, it's how you'll win and work with clients across the DACH region. Good English helps you collaborate smoothly with our team.
Bonus
  • First closing experience as AE: You've already brought your own deals over the line.
  • Knowledge of additional European languages, opening the door to further markets.
  • Existing network among relevant decision-makers in DACH.


Why revel8?

  • Our revelutionary Energy: A team that's ambitious, kind, and genuinely excited about what we're building. We move fast, we have fun, and we treat each other well.
  • Timing: Product-market fit is proven. The work now is to scale through rigorous execution.
  • Build, Don't Maintain: You take real ownership early, shape how we sell in DACH, and see your decisions reflected directly in our pipeline and ARR, not a small lever inside a corporate machine.
  • Shared success: Every team member is part of our ESOP program, so everyone shares in what we build.
  • Office-first: In the heart of Munich at Stiglmaierplatz, with flexibility when you need it. Unlimited coffee, table tennis and good vibes included.
  • EGYM Wellpass membership for your daily balance.


Ready to join the revelution?

Perfect, let's talk!

Just submit your application, and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to Melina or Helena from our People & Culture Team. We're looking forward to receiving your application!

data.title: Technical Business Analyst (d/f/m)
data.description:
About us

Since 2000, has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms and , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.

Your mission

As part of our Market Support team for LMS Next/ParcelParcel, you will work alongside a Product Owner and a Business Analyst to keep the platform’s day-to-day operations running smoothly across all live markets (NL, BE, DE, ES, and soon FR) – from technical troubleshooting to customer-facing questions. You’ll work in a fast-paced, pragmatic, hands-on environment, with direct escalation paths to Tech when needed.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • You own the daily inflow of operational and technical support requests for LMS Next/ParcelParcel, acting as the first point of contact and triage before issues are escalated to Product/Tech.
  • You independently diagnose technical issues, such as payment integration failures, frontend display bugs or carrier-specific issues, and determine whether they can be resolved directly or need to be passed on to Tech.
  • You are the point of contact for operational questions about LMS Next/ParcelParcel from internal stakeholders across Customer Service, Sales and Invoicing.
  • You investigate and document the root causes of recurring bugs.

What you need to succeed

  • You have a good technical understanding of web applications, APIs and third-party integrations (e.g. payment providers, carrier APIs, frontend and backend), enabling you to identify where a technical issue originates – coding skills to fix it are not required.
  • You are comfortable working with data to investigate issues independently, e.g. using Metabase, database queries or logs, rather than relying solely on someone else’s assessment.
  • You have experience in Technical Support or as a Technical Business Analyst, ideally in e-commerce, logistics or a SaaS/platform environment.
  • You are fluent in English and have a very good command of German and/or Dutch.
  • You are self-organized and able to independently triage and prioritize an unpredictable daily inflow of requests.
  • You are a strong communicator and can explain technical concepts clearly to internal stakeholders from non-technical teams.
  • You are thorough and detail-oriented, with the patience required for careful bug diagnosis rather than focusing only on quick fixes.
  • You stay calm under pressure and are comfortable working in an operational environment where issues often require an immediate response.

Why ITA Logistics Group?

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

data.title: System Administrator (w/m/d) Defense Products
data.description:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Join our highly motivated team of experts dedicated to combating cybersecurity threats. As a System Administrator, you will plan and operate our cutting-edge defense platforms alongside site reliability engineers and network engineers. These platforms are crucial for protecting our hosting products and infrastructure, encompassing classic DDoS mitigation, modern Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Zero Trust strategies, and our Content Delivery Network (CDN). We foster a culture that highly values creative ideas, agile working methods, initiative, and participation.

As an Specialist in our Defense squad, you act as a vital shield against daily DDoS and sophisticated cyber attacks. You are the first line of defense, dedicated to neutralizing threats through technical mastery and proactive mitigation.

We are hiring for this role in Karlsruhe and/or Berlin. You will join a distributed, international Defense Platform Services team of approximately 8–9 experts. You will work within specialized squads for Operations, SRE, and NRE to provide comprehensive protection for the group’s infrastructure across Germany and beyond.

Tasks

The day-to-day operations of the Defense Platform Services team directly correlate to the financial stability of the United Internet Group. When our defenders succeed, the group’s digital economy remains fluid; your success is measured by the silence of a neutralized threat.

  • Active Defense & DDoS Mitigation: Administer and troubleshoot scrubbing platforms and a complex, large-scale proxy infrastructure. You will engage in the "cat and mouse game" of fighting attacks in real-time—identifying, washing, and neutralizing malicious traffic to protect core cloud and fiber services.
  • Architectural Density & Operational Excellence: You will manage the lifecycle of 800+ Linux-based components within a highly available infrastructure. To maintain 24/7 group-wide protection, this role requires a mandatory on-call service rotation of one week per month, ensuring immediate response to high-priority network threats.
  • Innovation & Data-Driven Defense: We leverage modern AI tools for log analysis and pattern detection. You will bring creative ideas to the table, utilizing the ELK Stack and ClickHouse to manage high-volume telemetry, identify attack signatures, and devise advanced mitigation strategies.
  • Lifecycle & Pipeline Management: Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines in an agile DevOps environment. You will evaluate and integrate new technologies—including Docker and Kubernetes—to ensure our defense architecture remains lean, efficient, and ahead of evolving industry threats.

Qualifications

Because this role manages critical national and corporate infrastructure, the barrier to entry involves both technical mastery and a high degree of professional trust.Therefore, we require 3 to 5 years of platform operating experience at scale. We are looking for an administrator with a "security gene"—a specialized, proactive interest in DDoS mitigation and cyber defense that goes beyond standard system maintenance.

  • Expert-level proficiency in managing complex, distributed Linux environments.

data.title: Principal Product Manager- Time to First Production
data.description:
Register Here!

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

From the moment a team opens Camunda for the first time, our job is to help them succeed — fast. As Principal Product Manager for Time to First Production, you'll own exactly that experience: the journey from a new team's very first workspace (or first local start) to their first process running confidently in production. Your mission is simple to say and genuinely exciting to build: make that first win happen sooner, more smoothly, and more reliably than ever before.

You'll be the DRI for one of Product Strategy's three company-wide outcome areas, with real license to shape it — define what a great first experience looks like, build the measurement that proves we're delivering it, and set the strategy and priorities that Engineering, Design, and our Experience org build against. It's a founding-type mandate: the outcome area is established and the ambition is clear, and you'll have the room to define the metric, the roadmap, and the experience that gets us there.

You'll work at the intersection of Camunda's push into agentic, AI-first ways of building (AI-assisted modeling, agentic development, ProcessOS-style process re-engineering) and the fundamentals of a great first-run experience (onboarding, guided building, testing, and the path to production). It's a role for someone who loves turning a bold, company-wide ambition — delight customers from day one — into a measurable, funded, and genuinely exciting product

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Own the Time to First Production outcome area end to end: define its north-star metric(s), the customer journey they represent, and the roadmap of investments ("rocks" and initiatives) that move them.

  • Partner with the Validation team to build best-in-class, end-to-end measurement of the journey, so we always know exactly how well we're delivering for new teams and where to invest next.

  • Set direction and make prioritization calls across a portfolio of initiatives spanning AI-assisted and agentic building experiences, guided onboarding, testing/validation tooling, the path to production, and human-in-the-loop process experiences — in close partnership with Engineering, Design, and Experience pod leads.

  • Represent this outcome area to SLT, Product Marketing, and GTM, translating fast-moving product work into a clear, evidence-based narrative for internal and external audiences.

  • Collaborate closely with fellow Outcome DRIs (Enterprise Adoption, Production Confidence) to keep the three outcome areas coherent as one product strategy, and to hand work cleanly across the outcome boundaries (e.g., "first process" vs. "the second process and beyond").

  • Bring an outside-in, evidence-based lens — grounding roadmap decisions in real customer needs and feedback, not internal assumptions.

What You Bring:

  • Significant experience as a Principal/Staff-level Product Manager owning a cross-cutting, metrics-driven outcome or platform area (not a single feature surface) in B2B or enterprise SaaS.

  • A track record of building measurement and north-star metrics from scratch — comfortable partnering with data/analytics functions to go from "we don't really know" to a credible, trusted number.

  • Strong influence and cross-functional leadership skills: you can align Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive stakeholders around a strategy without relying on formal authority.

  • Excellent written communication — this role's primary tool is the strategy document that others build against, so clear, structured writing matters as much as decision-making.

  • A genuine passion for customer experience, paired with comfort shaping your own remit as the outcome area, its metric, and its roadmap continue to evolve.

  • An interest in (or track record with) AI-native and agentic ways of working — Camunda's product organization is actively building for a world where AI agents build, test, and even help re-engineer processes.

Nice to Haves:

  • Background in process automation, workflow orchestration, BPM, or developer platforms.

  • Experience partnering with Product Marketing / Analyst Relations on category or outcome-level positioning.

  • Experience in a company mid-transition to an AI-first product operating model.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-SK1 #LI-Remote #USEAST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $198,500.00 to $320,000.00

  • United Kingdom: £124,600.00 to £204,900.00

  • Singapore: S$246,500.00 to S$369,700.00

  • Canada: C$210,700.00 to C$346,600.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Data Scientist - Partner Flow

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team

You'll own experimentation and analytics for iwoca's partner channel – fintechs and platforms that embed iwoca lending in their own products. The analytical approach is still being built, and the scope to shape it is wide.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the customer journey from the moment someone starts an application on a partner platform through to a completed credit assessment. By making the application process as smooth as possible and collecting the data needed for a credit decision efficiently, the team maximises the number of partner-referred customers that receive an offer. The team works across the full application stack – from the APIs partners use to integrate iwoca, through to the experience customers see when they apply.

The team is small and cross-functional, combining data science, engineering, design, and product. Active projects include:

  • Pre-qualification – testing how showing customers an offer before they apply affects conversion and long-term value

  • Credit card strategy – iwoca recently launched a credit card alongside its flexi-loan; the team is working out which product, or combination, to offer which customers

  • Funnel optimisation – identifying and reducing the biggest points of friction across the partner journey

The role

You'll design experiments, model customer behaviour and analyse large data sets across the partner funnel, and turn findings into product and strategy decisions. The analytical approach is still being shaped - you'll influence how it develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences – on partner platforms, iwoca competes for attention alongside other lenders, and what this team builds and tests affects which customers convert and on what terms. You'll work closely with commercial, strategy, and product colleagues across the business.

  • Experimentation and causal inference. You'll design and analyse experiments where careful randomisation and interpretation are critical. You'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. The problems are consequential: measuring how pre-qualification affects Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), and understanding how different products interact when offered to the same customer base.

  • Funnel and competitive strategy. You'll analyse the full partner-referred customer journey – from application through to credit assessment – identifying where conversion breaks down and why. On partner platforms, iwoca is positioned alongside competitors, so you'll also figure out what makes customers choose iwoca over the alternatives, and how to shift those dynamics in our favour.

  • Commercial translation. You'll be directly involved when decisions get made – not handing off analysis to be interpreted by someone else. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and coordinate with adjacent teams to make sure the tests and policies you run fit together with their ongoing work.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work. The team treats this as a lever for increasing its rate of learning. You'll be expected to have a view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. Strong grounding in probability and statistics, with an understanding of Bayesian reasoning and experience applying hierarchical modelling or decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Causal inference. Experience separating signal from noise in observational and experimental data.

  • Business translation. Ability to understand commercial context and translate data into actionable insights that guide decisions - not just produce analysis, but land it with people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. Proficiency with data manipulation and modelling tools.

  • Analytical ownership. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end - from framing through modelling to influencing decisions.

  • AI fluency. Experience with and a passion for using AI to accelerate and automate analysis and model building.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, adapting technical detail to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. Experience building or adapting statistical or ML models, with an interest in understanding what's happening underneath.

  • Stochastic methods. Familiarity with stochastic modelling concepts as they apply to inference, time series, or uncertainty.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. Experience with conversion funnel analysis or marketplace dynamics where you're competing for attention alongside competitors.

  • Python. You work primarily in Python. If your background is R or another language, that's fine - but Python is what the team uses day to day.

  • Market curiosity. You want to understand how the partner lending market actually works - what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 – £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • Interview welcome pack

You will own what you build from prototype to production. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts and engineers across Payment Performance, and collaborate regularly with other product teams and with the relationship managers who own our issuer partnerships.

What we're looking for:

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

You will own partnerships for ElevenCreative across the agency and platform ecosystem.

Marketing, creative, and performance teams are rapidly changing how they produce advertising and content, and much of that work reaches brands through agencies and through the platforms those teams already use every day. This role sits at that intersection.

ElevenCreative is our AI creative platform, where creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video using leading AI models. You will build senior relationships across performance and creative agencies and across product and platform partners, define how those partnerships work commercially, and turn them into measurable product adoption and revenue.

This is a true 0→1 role. You will help shape which partner models work, which agency segments create the most leverage, and where product integrations can unlock meaningful distribution.

The strongest candidates understand both sides of this market: how agencies help brands drive growth across marketing, creative, content, and performance, and how technology platforms become embedded in the tools and workflows marketers use every day.

In this role, you will;

  • Identify and prioritize the agency and platform partners where ElevenCreative can create the most value and build senior relationships across them.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how agencies make money, where they create margin and differentiation, and how AI can strengthen their value to clients.

  • Stay close to the evolving AI creative landscape, customer use cases, competitive dynamics, and emerging distribution models.

  • Use partner and customer feedback to help shape product priorities and identify where ElevenCreative should invest.

  • Represent ElevenCreative with partners at industry events, conferences, executive meetings, and customer conversations.

Who you are;

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial instincts with a practical understanding of how agencies and technology platforms actually operate.

  • You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience across agency partnerships, advertising technology, performance marketing, business development, platform partnerships, or digital advertising sales.

  • Have deep familiarity with the performance marketing and creative ecosystem and how agencies acquire, serve, and grow advertiser accounts.

  • Have a strong network across independent agencies, agency networks, holding companies, or relevant technology platforms that you can activate quickly.

  • Understand agency economics, how agencies price services, create margin, differentiate with clients, and decide which technologies become part of their delivery model.

  • Have experience working on technology or product partnerships, particularly integrations involving creative tools, advertising platforms, martech, commerce, social platforms, or APIs.

  • Have operated effectively across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Engineering in fast-moving environments.

Bonus;

  • Experience with AI-generated creative, voice, video, localization, or generative media.

Location;

Must be based in either London, Paris, New York or san Francisco

data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.

  • Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required.


Experience - Desirable

  • Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures.

  • Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware.

  • Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.

The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.

What you'll work on

  • Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain 
  • Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
  • Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.

Our humble expectations

We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.

  • You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
  • You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.

  • You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.

  • You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
  • You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

data.title: Head of Fraud, Payments & Banking
data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As Head of Fraud, Payments & Banking, you'll own the strategy, governance, and day-to-day execution of Kraken's payments and banking fraud prevention programs, from front-line detection and analyst operations through policy design and executive reporting. This role carries a strong mandate to bring a consistent global coverage lens across all markets — ensuring fraud controls, payments oversight, and banking risk programs meet the highest regulatory bar across every jurisdiction we operate in.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the end-to-end payments and banking fraud prevention strategy across all Kraken products, setting the vision, roadmap, and OKRs in collaboration with Product, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Legal

  • Build, lead, and mentor a multi-tiered fraud organization — analysts, investigators, and managers — establishing career progression frameworks with clear advancement criteria

  • Work closely with the Executive Team and regulators to stay ahead of emerging fraud trends, techniques, and technologies across the payments and banking industry, directing in-depth analysis to proactively identify and close vulnerabilities

  • Monitor payment trends and regulatory shifts, identifying opportunities to optimize approval/decline rates and revenue while maintaining fraud discipline

  • Design, implement, and maintain payments and banking fraud policies, rule frameworks, and control processes across all products

  • Maintain Risk assessment, mitigation, Governance and Audit controls

  • Lead comprehensive risk assessments and implement preventive controls that support governance, audit, and regulatory requirements

  • Oversee payments and banking fraud detection systems and tools, and own escalation pathways for complex or novel fraud cases in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Customer Support

  • Ensure the analyst team maintains SLA and QA standards across high-volume, real-time alert queues

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between payments and banking Fraud Operations and Customer Support, Compliance, Legal, Product, and Security

  • Direct data analysis and reporting on fraud and payment KPIs, delivering clear, actionable reporting on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence to executive leadership

  • Apply a consistent global coverage standard across all markets, ensuring they are proactively tracked and embedded into policy rather than addressed reactively

 

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in banking, payment processing, or fraud risk management, including experience building or leading a fraud team

  • Demonstrated experience managing both strategic fraud/payments programs and front-line, high-volume analyst operations

  • Proven track record with Card, Third-Party, and Peer-to-Peer payment fraud, along with relevant banking regulatory and compliance frameworks

  • Working knowledge of UK and other non-US regulatory regimes (e.g., FCA, PSR) relevant to fraud, payments, and banking; experience operating under, or reporting to, a UK/EU regulator strongly preferred given the team's non-US footprint

  • Strong understanding of blockchain technology, cryptocurrencies, and associated fraud risks preferred

  • Solid grounding in data analytics and reporting, with a track record of using data-driven insight to guide decisions

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders

  • Experience developing career frameworks, coaching managers, and scaling operational teams

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Business Administration, Finance) preferred
